description: Case-insensitive keyword search across merged CHIPs and open PR drafts. Matches against title, description, abstract, authors, and CHIP number. Optional filters: status, source (merged | draft | both, default both), limit (default 20).

query.description: Case-insensitive keyword matched against title, description, abstract, and authors.

source.description: Where to search: 'merged' (CHIPs on main), 'draft' (open PRs), or 'both' (default).

status.description: Restrict to a status, e.g. 'Final', 'Review', 'Draft', 'Last Call', 'Living', 'Stagnant', 'Withdrawn', 'Obsolete'. Case-insensitive.

name: search_chips
